identityAssessment.finding: The imported feature covers approximately 126.91 to 121.33 degrees west and 59.27 to 61.21 degrees north around the Fort Liard region. The subject is Acho Dene Koe, not all Dene peoples or the separate Dene Tha’ First Nation. Exact imported borders remain unverified.

scopeNotes: The 2021 fishing report gives 1921 for local treaty adherence. The original Fort Liard adhesion and the Nation’s 2024 plan support 1922, which is used here.
The craft enterprise’s About page begins with material about Fort Providence. Only its separate Fort Liard paragraphs are used.
No local visit by Martin Frobisher is inferred from the wellness plan’s general territorial introduction.
Craft instructions describe current practice and tools, not an unchanged prehistoric process.
The imported polygon is not substituted for a negotiated title boundary.
